name: – Recital G – Am 15
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: G.whereas EU legislation establishes a reduction target of at least 55 % for net GHG emissions by 2030, and a 90 % reduction target by 2040, compared to 1990, including associated flexibilities and with up to 5 % achievable via high-quality international carbon credits from 2036 onwards, based on a technology-neutral approach, ensuring European industrial competitiveness and energy security and structurally respecting the national energy mix of the Member States;
